title: Union of Myanmar

endonym.native: ပြည်ထောင်စု မြန်မာနိုင်ငံတော်

capsule: The Union of Myanmar was the name adopted in 1989 by the ruling State Law and Order Restoration Council for the state formerly called Burma, its military-junta rule (SLORC, then SPDC) persisting until a nominally civilian government took office in 2011 under the 2008 constitution. A decade of partial democratization under Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy followed, ending abruptly when the military seized power again in the February 2021 coup. This post-1989 entity is distinct from the earlier Konbaung-through-socialist 'Burma' sharing this Wikidata identifier.
